g.title: lifecycle
g.text: The life of a message (bot.py → core.py → agent → services → reply)

g.title: router
g.text: one AnyJev L0 decision · p per option

g.title: wf
g.text: params by one typed extraction → run in a thread

g.title: reply
g.text: adapter renders: Telegram message + inline buttons

g.title: plan
g.text: plan_turn: typed plan (≤4 steps, schema = grammar)
reply = each answer under its label

g.title: prep
g.text: history (+ rolling summary) · thread of recent turns
memory view (index + 4 tools) · library / sandbox / bill tools
hand_off · ask · Guard capability · Budget capability

g.title: after
g.text: old turns → rolling summary (background) · facts pass (background)

g.title: run
g.text: model request → tool calls → model request → … → text

g.title: check
g.text: fail → sent back once; stop → fallback text

g.title: defer
g.text: tainted write the user didn't ask for

g.title: tap
g.text: the Proposal's apply() runs the same tool without the model
